question: Can the existing aligned Hangzhou source package meet the same physical admission rule as the repaired Jinan main-demand network while retaining the two cities' previously registered measurement movements?
source: Use the Hangzhou aligned v1 cfg in source_reuse.json and its original bound CityFlow roadnet, demand, runtime, eight phase choices and native car parameters. Keep Jinan's passed geometry candidate fixed. Preserve all old receipts.
before_build: Bind all 32 jointly protected, mutually conflicting opposed-left lane pairs to physical source laneLinks and source phases. Check their source curves, inlet/outlet endpoints and widths. Stop before compilation if intended joint service and separated source trajectories cannot be established.
construction_and_gate: Build at most one isolated Hangzhou candidate. Compile the final signal plans together with the applicable g/G yielding relations and adapt only the source-supported opposed-left curves to existing lane endpoints. Require identical physical action and demand semantics, continuous emitted target curves and clear width envelopes, unchanged off-target paths, all 64 common-outlet right/straight movements yielding correctly and no newly conflicting or unresolved independent co-green relations. If a requirement fails, record the first candidate and stop.
conditional_pp: After static admission, use the two historical source development seeds 32061101 and 32061102 for at most one native 3600-second PP hour each in order. Stop on the first collision, teleport or incomplete record. Retain the preaction census at ten-second epochs to avoid a separate pass. Bind the old 32 source movement pairs by physical identity; keep the newly admitted pairs outside the prediction roster. Tabulate the six old right/straight count points, nominal high/low 4/0 eligibility and two stopped straight leaders. Do not open alternative-action labels.
afterward: Once both network packages qualify, freeze source and target development rosters from preaction data, retaining the old Jinan 24 measurement movements. Re-estimate the six-stratum source and target rates on those packages. Freeze forecasts and the matched pure-target and source controls before looking at a separate untouched native Jinan prediction panel. The four v9 safety-stop seeds and the development seeds remain outside independent prediction evaluation.
